seasons.name: Upper Thailand seasonal context
seasons.summary: Cooler period roughly mid-October to mid-February; heat before the rains; rainy season roughly mid-May to mid-October. Road closures, smoke and storms need separate current observations.

seasons.name: Southern Thailand east-coast contrast
seasons.summary: The east coast can remain wet late in the year. Other months stay unrated here rather than borrowing the north's seasonal model.

seasons.name: Northern Australia wet-season context
seasons.summary: Far-northern wet-season context about October to April. Dry-season labels do not confirm road access, temperature comfort or absence of cyclones.

seasons.name: New Zealand seasonal context
seasons.summary: Official broad seasons only. The South Island alpine roads need separate snow, wind, rainfall and road-status checks.

seasons.name: Patagonian Andes seasonal context
seasons.summary: Editorial mapping of the official regional description to southern seasons: snowy mountain winters and stronger summer winds. Not a measured monthly climate normal.

seasons.name: Southwestern Cape climate contrast
seasons.summary: Winter rainfall is an important contrast with summer-rainfall parts of South Africa. Only core winter context is mapped; remaining months are unrated.

seasons.name: Japan main islands: regional seasonal context
seasons.basis: Official qualitative overview with editorial month grouping; not an opening schedule
seasons.summary: Japan has distinct regional climates. Early-summer rainfall and late-summer/autumn storms matter; snowy mountain roads need their own closure sources. This overview is not applied to all Japanese road surfaces.

seasons.name: Northern Japan: snow-sensitive context
seasons.basis: Official qualitative regional overview with editorial month grouping
seasons.summary: Northern Japan has very cold winters, with heavy snow on the Sea of Japan side and in mountains. Summer temperatures and rain vary by region. These monthly groupings are editorial context, not pass-opening dates.

seasons.name: Singapore: monsoons and thunderstorm context
seasons.basis: Official explanation with editorial monthly grouping; not measured monthly rainfall
seasons.summary: Rain occurs throughout the year. Northeast-monsoon surges can bring prolonged rain, while inter-monsoon thunderstorms can be intense. The calendar does not identify a guaranteed dry riding month.
